boundaries: a significant late-window difference on one or two graphs is not evidence of patient bistability
two hand-picked initial states mixed at patient proportions are not a state-access mechanism
the 1 mV cold-start voltage probe covers a small part of state space; negatives do not exclude synaptic, inhibitory, adaptive or slow-variable states
route diagnostics are development checks on FIT only and feed nothing back into the probe

interpretation_bounds.PERSISTENT_INITIAL_STATE_EFFECT_SINGLE_G: opens I2 on a second graph; not a patient bistability claim
interpretation_bounds.SMALL_EFFECT_BOUNDED_FOR_TESTED_PROBE: effects above 10 points unsupported for this operating point, 1 mV probe and window
interpretation_bounds.INCONCLUSIVE: interval and event counts delivered; no seed or window changes
interpretation_bounds.STARTUP_SENSITIVITY_ONLY: difference confined to the start-up window; not persistent state selection
interpretation_bounds.NOT_ESTIMABLE: at least one pair lacks a late-window proportion; bounds reported
